32k5je:260: Anthropic's separation of Planner-Generator-Evaluator is essentially a systematic counter to the "self-evaluation hallucination." When an Agent generates code, its evaluation of its own output is systematically biased — it tends to believe its code is correct and fully functional. This bias cannot be fundamentally resolved with better Prompts; it must be counterbalanced by an external evaluation mechanism. This follows the same vein as software engineering's principle of "separating tests from implementation." A Generative Agent and the code under test have a conflict of interest (judging its own output); introducing an independent Evaluator dissolves that conflict at the architectural level.
